title: Encyclopaedia Britannica - Sixth edition, Volume 1, A-AME - EB.11
text: ALQUITOU, or Acustroo, is a sort of lead ore, which when broken, looks militancy. It is one by the potters to give a warmish to their works, and there is called _potterave_. He met with in Cornwally. The game mix a small portion of manganese with the alquifou, and then the varnish or glazing on the were wars in a kabakh bine.
